generation.scope: All closed points in every support of the homogeneous Klein marked bracket chart now have exact AS decisions, including the full zero-diagonal torus. Its four presentations use two signs and two nonzero spectral coordinates. Opposite signs are AS exactly off xy+x+y=0. Equal signs are always AS by smooth diagonal pencil or reducible pencil and evaluation, with the other case related by cocycle twist. Both equal-sign branches are graded; every regular window in the entire homogeneous marked chart has period dividing two.

open_mathematics: Extend the marked exponential growth obstruction beyond Klein supports using flags and coordinate-independent free monomial quotients. Determine the geometric cover of windows not meeting these charts, especially high-rank ones without symmetry.
